choices.reason: Both candidates test the paper's main H2a hypothesis, which does not distinguish the metrics; the linked preregistration was inaccessible. The paper selects LUAR-MUD for its analyses and repeats H1/H2 with CISR, so the main specification takes precedence over the alternative metric.
choices.locator: PDF pp. 14 and 16, Appendix B.2 (Style Embedding Model Selection), paragraph beginning 'In Table 2'; the quoted sentence continues after the intervening tables on p. 16.
choices.quote: LUAR-MUD performs best on this proxy task, so we use this model’s embeddings for the rest of our analysis. We also repeat our analysis for H1 and H2 using CISR.
